name: Uncommon File Created In Office Startup Folder
description: Detects the creation of a file with an uncommon extension in an Office application startup folder
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: False positive might stem from rare extensions used by other Office utilities.
query: (((file.path:*\\Microsoft\\Word\\STARTUP* OR (file.path:*\\Office* AND file.path:*\\Program\ Files* AND file.path:*\\STARTUP*)) AND (NOT (file.path:(*.docb OR *.docm OR *.docx OR *.dotm OR *.mdb OR *.mdw OR *.pdf OR *.wll OR *.wwl)))) OR ((file.path:*\\Microsoft\\Excel\\XLSTART* OR (file.path:*\\Office* AND file.path:*\\Program\ Files* AND file.path:*\\XLSTART*)) AND (NOT (file.path:(*.xll OR *.xls OR *.xlsm OR *.xlsx OR *.xlt OR *.xltm OR *.xlw))))) AND (NOT ((process.executable:*\:\\Program\ Files\\Common\ Files\\Microsoft\ Shared\\ClickToRun\\* AND process.executable:*\\OfficeClickToRun.exe) OR ((process.executable:(*\:\\Program\ Files\\Microsoft\ Office\\* OR *\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Microsoft\ Office\\*)) AND (process.executable:(*\\winword.exe OR *\\excel.exe)))))
